}}'''Feran''' is a [[Chareen]] [[Aiel]] and a member of the ''[[Seia Doon]]'' society.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Feran}} His greatfather is [[Sorilea]]'s sister-son.

== Appearance ==
He looks like [[Rhuarc]], but younger, taller and more handsome with redder hair. His face is described beautiful by Aviendha but she also says that Feran laughs like a braying mule and picks at his ears.

== Activities ==
On the way to Cairhien from the Aiel Waste [[Sorilea]] offers to set [[Aviendha]] up with Feran. Aviendha pretends to be open for that ''"when there is time"'' so that Sorilea will leave her alone. However for Egwene's question she reveals that she has never had interest in him and she knows that Feran has been trying to capture [[Enaila]]'s interest for over a year, though unsuccessful.{{ref/book|5|23}}
